takeaways: The strongest unused material is the Brian's House shoot: the RE-Colored dusk fire-pit patio (cell 7) and the daylight fire-pit shot (Brian's 24) are cover-grade and should lead work/sylvan-gardens and the work-index cover. John's House adds a real before/after for the case study (PAID AD Before 11 next to After 6) and lifestyle shots of friends on the new patio for blog:organic-social-growth-landscaping. The 10-frame Instagram Stories ad set is polished and belongs on service:digital-advertising. For the hero loop, unused Drone Clip 4 and Drone Vertical 4 match the drone clips already running, and the raw vertical fire-pit and dusk begonia clips (RAW/Videos 4, 9, 12) would add warmth. Crew picks (Aug 23 picnic group photo and portraits, April 2024 team photo 83, Zemke branded truck) can humanize the case study, while the Dec 2024 appreciation, headshot and raw folders are weak and heavily duplicated.
